root_cause.text: Integer overflow in komeda_fb_afbc_size_check when adding kfb->afbc_size and fb->offsets[0] without overflow check, allowing a craft framebuffer to bypass size validation and lead to out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `check_add_overflow()` to detect overflow and reject the framebuffer, replacing the unprotected addition `min_size = kfb->afbc_size + fb->offsets[0];`. The CVE description explicitly states that the addition overflows can cause the size check to incorrectly succeed and allow an undersized drm_gem_object, leading to out-of-bounds access.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add include for overflow-checking utilities to protect against integer overflow vulnerabilities.
intent_record.what: Added #include <linux/overflow.h> to the top of the file, before existing includes.
intent_record.how: This makes available overflow-checking macros (e.g., check_add_overflow, array_size) that help prevent integer overflow bugs in subsequent code that may perform arithmetic on sizes or indices.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace unsafe addition with overflow-checked addition to prevent integer overflow in AFBC size validation.
intent_record.what: Replaced direct addition of kfb->afbc_size and fb->offsets[0] with a call to check_add_overflow, jumping to check_failed label on overflow.
intent_record.how: Prevents integer overflow by using check_add_overflow; if overflow occurs, the function fails early, avoiding a wrapped min_size that could bypass the subsequent size check.

candidates.rationale: Integer overflow occurs when adding kfb->afbc_size and fb->offsets[0] without overflow check, allowing min_size to wrap to a small value and bypass the subsequent size check.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement performs an addition of kfb->afbc_size and fb->offsets[0] without overflow checking. An integer overflow can cause min_size to wrap to a small value, bypassing the subsequent size validation and leading to out-of-bounds memory access.
